---
name: Data issue
about: Report a problem with opening, player, database, or reference data
title: '[data] '
labels: data
---

## What data?

Which data source? _Databases → Reference sources_ has the canonical
names; one of:

- [ ] Kingfisher Starter Reference (built in)
- [ ] Elite OTB Reference
- [ ] Recent Theory Reference
- [ ] High-Rated Online Reference
- [ ] High-Rated Rapid & Classical Online Reference
- [ ] Lichess (online)
- [ ] My games, or a database of yours (please describe)
- [ ] Other: ___

## What were you trying to do?

The question you wanted the data to answer. "What does Carlsen play
against the Sicilian" is a question. "Sicilian B90" is an ECO code.
Tell us the question.

## What happened?

The wrong answer, the missing row, the silent merge, the surprising
blank, the slow load. The exact behaviour matters more than the
wording.

## What did you expect?

What the data should have answered. Be specific — a name, a year, an
ECO, a position.

## Kingfisher version

From _Kingfisher → About Kingfisher_ in the Mac application, or the
`Settings → Diagnostics` panel on either. The "Copy support
information" button there captures it.

## Where

- [ ] Web
- [ ] macOS desktop

## Operating system

macOS / Windows / Linux and the version (e.g. macOS 14.5).

## Source state

Open _Databases → Reference sources_ and tell us the state each source
shows — _Installed_, _Update available_, _Cached · partial_,
_Online · cached_, _Available online_, _Not installed_ or _Failed_.

A screenshot is fine.

## Anything else?

If the data is from a personal import, the **content** stays on
your machine — do not paste a private PGN into a public issue.
Attach a file with a single game if it is safe to share, and tell
us what to expect when we open it.
